name: Itinerary builder
purpose: Turns a client brief into a draft day-by-day itinerary with a per-person price range, built only from our tours, partner hotels and drive times.

inputs.name: client_brief
inputs.label: Client brief (their own words)
inputs.hint: Paste the client's message or your call notes.

inputs.name: travellers
inputs.label: Travellers
inputs.hint: For example: 2 adults, or 3 adults and 1 child (9).

inputs.name: pace_mobility
inputs.label: Pace and mobility
inputs.hint: Anyone who cannot manage steps, hills or long walks must be named here.

output.description: Markdown with four headings: Overview, Day by day, Price estimate, Open questions. 600 words or fewer.

do: Fill in mobility even when it is "none": the plan depends on it.
Check every drive time and price against the knowledge files before sending.
Price children, single rooms and unlisted items by hand.
dont: Do not send the estimate as a quote.
Do not let the assistant add venues, hotels or prices that we do not sell.
Do not plan Theth outside June to September or anything outside our coverage.

modelSettings.notes: A little variety in the wording is fine; the plan itself is limited by the knowledge files. Web browsing off so no outside venues creep in.

paste.chatgpt: Explore GPTs, Create, Configure tab. Paste the Instructions block into Instructions, upload the three knowledge files under Knowledge, switch Web search off.
paste.claude: Projects, Create project. Paste instructions.md into Set project instructions and add the three knowledge files under Project knowledge.

examples.title: Family with a grandmother who cannot manage steps, tight budget
Winter Theth hike and Dubrovnik request
